Help

How to play
Left stick
move
Slash
auto-aims at the nearest enemy
Dash
brief invulnerable burst
Controller
left stick move · right stick aim · RT slash · LT dash. In menus the left stick moves a crosshair, A clicks, B goes back, Start does the main action. Rebind buttons under Settings, then Controls
Spin
every third swing hits all around you
Coins
earned from runs (2 per 5 waves cleared) and by leveling up your account (10 per level, 100 on every 10th level). Spend them on loot boxes in the Shop
Boss
every tenth wave, tougher each time
Vault
a boss drops a key. Carry it to the gold door for a chest full of gold. The wave 10, 30, 60 and 90 bosses also give a secret ability
Loop
beat the wave 100 boss, then end the run or loop back to wave 1. Each loop is tougher, adds a stacking ×1.2 XP boost and doubles all coins you earn
Hotbar
the vault chest after the wave 10, 30, 60 and 90 bosses offers a secret ability. It goes on your hotbar (bottom left). Press its hotbar key (1–4 by default), click or tap the slot, or use the controller (D-pad by default). Keys and buttons can be rebound under Controls. Each has a cooldown
XP
every wave you clear earns account XP, banked when the run ends. Levels cost more each time
Fighter levels
every character levels up on its own from the XP it earns. You start with Common and Uncommon abilities, and higher fighter levels unlock Rare, Epic, Legendary and Mythic ones in the shop and vault

Controls

Click a slot, then press a key or mouse button. Click the same slot again to use the left button. Esc cancels and Backspace clears.

Odds per box: Mythic 1/1000 · Legendary 1/400 · Epic 1/100 · Rare 1/50 · Uncommon 1/20, otherwise Common. Pity: your 1000th box is a guaranteed Mythic (once per save). Duplicates refund a few coins. Only Mythic weapons and pets have special effects: glow, particles and an aura.
